## Governance checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the currently declared product capability.
- [ ] Repository-local checks remain deterministic and do not require secrets.
- [ ] A new JavaScript/TypeScript stack includes exactly one lockfile and non-empty `check` and `build` scripts.
- [ ] Browser, data, external-service or deployment gates are added only when that capability exists.
- [ ] Pull-request validation does not receive deployment authority.
